consequence.statement: New optional capability to drop labels in lambda-promtail; nothing changes for operators who do nothing.

original.statement: Lambda-Promtail gains support for dropping labels passed via an environment variable (the variable name is not stated).

decision.reason: [ev-0d57af90ad19] lists this under Features as "Add support for dropping labels passed via env var" in Lambda-Promtail. That describes a new opt-in capability that only takes effect when the variable is supplied. The evidence describes no failure, changed default or required step for environments that do nothing, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because "nothing changes" is inferred from "add support for", not stated outright.
